Origin and meaning

The name Micah has Hebrew roots and means “who is like God?”.

About the name Micah

The prophet Micah predicted that the Messiah would be born in Bethlehem.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Micah as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “who is like God?”, is part of the appeal.
